system.description:
Trigger: As part of casting a Jutsu

When you cast a Jutsu with the Water release keyword that affects an area, you can use this surge to cause the affected area to become difficult terrain for the next minute for all creatures, excluding yourself and up to 3 creatures of your choice.

Creatures that attempt to move through this area can spend 10 chakra to ignore this difficult terrain effect until the end of their turn.
